notes:
## Changes

- Simplify releases to a single `BnlCommunityFixes.exe`
- Move the replay analyzer into the launcher itself via `--analyze-replay`
- Remove the need to ship `BnlUpdater.exe` and `BnlCommunityFixes.ReplayAnalyzer.exe` in the public release
- Keep self-update support using an internal launcher update-helper mode
- Relax Steam login-state validation so launch is only blocked when Steam is not running
- Continue shipping the recent audio, mesh, texture, and importer UX improvements
